name: 48310 · Sterling Hts, MI
findings: ZIP 48310 (Sterling Hts) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48310 (Sterling Hts) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48310 (Sterling Hts) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
